detail.title: Unrecognized Reasoning Limits and Automated Error Detection
detail.summary: Statistical frameworks for time-series analysis allow for the detection of model reasoning boundaries. Stronger reasoning abilities in LLMs do not necessarily prevent catastrophic failure, necessitating automated, statistically-grounded performance monitoring.
detail.reason: Linking statistical frameworks for analyzing variability with findings on LLM reasoning risks.

detail.title: Objective Misspecification and Goal Criticism
detail.summary: Autonomous agents optimizing objectives face structural challenges that can be mitigated through advanced goal-identity configurations, combining hierarchical goal decomposition and simulative reasoning grounded in separately trained world models.
